title: Classify European clan bank table alias
changes: Identify the unowned European 20-byte table that aliases five existing managed clan banks and document its six original selector sequences.
validation: Five authenticated original source windows and an aligned literal census identify five direct references and six raw-language selection and decoder sequences; eight source and dataset inputs remain unchanged.
Two source windows were disassembled with the existing Windows executable under Wine; no gameplay or previous acceptance was repeated.
limitations: Indirect references, ordinary use, model and runtime ownership, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurement.
